Burada söyleyemeyeceğim şekilde kadınları objeleştirmiş; ekonomik kalkınmayla, kaldırımların yüksekliğiyle, kadınların güzelliğinin paralel olduğunu dile getirmiş. Yakışık almadı.

The professor is a professional on the topic of analytical writing and his lessons are highly informative and valuable for our future careers. I feel that he could have provided more positive examples when discussing the problems with our papers as it is difficult to understand what we should do when we are only told what we shouldnt do. Nevertheless, it is a very good course and I strongly recommend it.
